title: Red alert in Delhi after heavy rain lashes parts of city

title: Delhi man goes for infertility test, finds out he has uterus
content: A 26-year-old man seeking infertility treatment discovered a rare congenital condition.  He had a uterus and fallopian-tube-like structures inside his body.  Doctors also found undescended testes with severe damage and pre-cancerous changes.  Minimally invasive surgery removed these structures and the damaged testes.  The case highlights the importance of investigating unexplained infertility and undescended testes.

India's pricing reflects higher local taxes and import duties on electronics.

title: Elon Musk feels 'chess will be fully solved one day'; what does Carlsen think?
content: Elon Musk believes chess will eventually be fully solved by AI, drawing comparisons with checkers. Magnus Carlsen was less certain, saying he isn't a computer expert but noting chess is already “semi-solved” as a likely draw. Carlsen also praised AI for making chess more accessible, while backing the Global Chess League’s exciting team format and enjoying his visits to India.

title: US-based couple flags ‘scam’ at Delhi airport, authorities respond
content: A US-based Indian couple alleged passport scanning of their young children at Delhi airport. Staff scanned multiple family passports after one purchase, claiming to check for offers. The couple raised concerns about data collection and potential misuse of personal information. Airport authorities have acknowledged the allegation and promised a thorough investigation. Exemplary action will be taken if the allegations are found to be true.

title: 1980s AI Photo trend: 5 ChatGPT prompts to create Kerala-style retro images
content: A social media trend uses ChatGPT to recreate photos in 1980s styles. Users are now focusing on regional aesthetics, specifically 1980s Kerala and Malayali culture. Prompts request authentic family, wedding, college, and studio portraits from the period. These images incorporate traditional clothing, jewellery, and home settings from Kerala. The AI maintains recognizable facial features while adding retro photographic elements.

title: This snake grows a fake spider on its tail to lure birds
content: Researchers utilized XCT scanning technology to investigate the unique tail of a viper. The imaging uncovered the presence of standard viper vertebrae within the tail's unusual form. This finding underscores the discrepancies that can exist between external appearance and internal skeletal makeup. Fossilized remains alone may not capture the true look of an organism, while museum specimens remain crucial for advancing our understanding through innovative methods.

title: Max Thieriot turned 90-acre Sonoma ranch into vineyard, farm and retreat
content: Max Thieriot’s roughly 90-acre Sonoma County ranch has evolved since he and his wife Lexi bought it in 2013. The property now includes the nine-acre Bodega Thieriot Pinot noir vineyard, while the rest remains hillside, woodland and pasture. Though the actor’s family now lives in Washington state for most of the year, he continues returning to the ranch during the off-season.

title: iPhone 18 Pro, Pro Max go on pre-order tomorrow: 9 biggest features to know
content: Apple's iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone 18 Pro Max are priced from Rs 1,64,900 and Rs 1,79,900 in India. The new Pro models bring a variable aperture main camera, Pro controls, Apple Reference Image, the 2nm A20 Pro chip, a bigger vapour chamber and up to 43 hours of video playback. Pre-orders start September 12, with sales from September 18. Here are the nine features that you should know of before ordering one.

title: Why Caitlin Clark chose Iowa over Notre Dame and changed her career
content: Caitlin Clark almost opted for Notre Dame in 2019, but her decision to join Iowa turned out to be a pivotal moment in her basketball journey. With a vision to elevate Iowa's program, she not only became the NCAA's all-time leading scorer but also led her team to two championship appearances, making her choice to remain home a defining chapter in her storied college career.

title: Bank delays release of deceased wife's savings to elderly man; ordered to pay Rs 15K
content: A Kerala consumer commission ordered Bank of India to pay compensation for service deficiency. The bank delayed releasing a deceased woman's savings to her elderly husband. The commission found the bank's procedures unnecessarily burdensome and lacking clear communication. The bank failed to prove its defense regarding an unsigned application. The elderly man suffered financial hardship and mental agony due to the bank's actions.

title: 'He shouldn't be here': Nasser Hussain bashes Pakistan with Sehwag example
content: Saim Ayub’s return to the Pakistan Test team ended in a nightmare as he was dismissed for a duck in both innings of the third Test against England at Edgbaston. The young opener faced only 11 balls across the two innings, with England pacer Ollie Robinson dismissing him on both occasions.

title: 'Promised to boost followers': Delhi influencer 'raped' by ASI’s associate

One of them alleges she was raped and then blackmailed with a video recording. She claims she was pressured to modify her statement following her complaint. Additionally, two other women report harassment and inappropriate messages from the officer, leading to a police and SSB investigation into these allegations.

title: Quote of the day by Brad Pitt on self-discovery; actor reflects on faith and identity
content: Brad Pitt openly reflects on his transformative journey away from a conservative religious upbringing. He emphasizes that this shift was an empowering journey of self-discovery rather than a simple abandonment of faith. His experiences resonate deeply with those grappling with their own belief systems, revealing the power of trusting one’s abilities to confront life’s adversities. Pitt's story underscores the value of introspection and personal agency in shaping one’s path.

title: 'Mirzapur The Movie' BO Day 8 [LIVE]: Pankaj Tripathi film eyes Rs 150 crore
content: 'Mirzapur The Movie' is edging closer to a major box office milestone as it enters Day 8, with its India net collection standing at Rs. 149.26 crore after crossing Rs. 148 crore by the end of Day 7. The Pankaj Tripathi, Ali Fazal and Ravi Kishan starrer is now less than a crore away from the Rs. 150 mark, even as Akshay Kumar and Saif Ali Khan's 'Haiwaan' opens in theatres. Worldwide, the film has already surpassed Rs. 212 crore.

title: Watch: Fed up over poor network, villagers tie technician with mobile tower
content: Villagers held a mobile tower technician captive for two hours in Fatehpur district. They were frustrated with poor mobile connectivity for approximately two years. Police intervened and rescued the technician after being alerted by another villager. An FIR was registered against unknown villagers following the technician's complaint. Investigations are currently underway regarding the unusual incident.

title: Miami flight overrun: Plane touched down at nearly 300 kmph despite high-speed warning
content: A 21 Air Boeing 767 touched down at Miami International Airport at an alarming speed of nearly 300 kmph. As the crew attempted to execute a go-around following the landing, they had neglected to deploy the speed brakes, leading to automated alerts about the steep descent and proximity to the ground. Investigators are now analyzing the flight data and cockpit voice recordings to uncover further insights regarding this incident.

title: Catastrophic failure: Bangladesh tank blast puts Chinese military hardware under spotlight
content: A Chinese-origin tank exploded during an exercise, killing two soldiers and injuring another.  This incident follows other nations reporting issues with Chinese military equipment.  Several countries have expressed dissatisfaction with Chinese defense system capabilities.  China remains a major global arms supplier despite these persistent quality complaints.  Bangladesh is still considering purchasing Chinese fighter jets despite past equipment problems.

title: Hindu monk, in Bangladesh jail, gets 5-hour parole to attend mother's funeral
content: Chattogram district deputy commissioner Mohammad Zahidul Islam Mia ordered his release after Das’s family submitted an application. title: Saif Ali Khan's Pataudi Palace: Inside 'Haiwaan' actor's ancestral home
content: The Pataudi Palace, an ancestral estate of Saif Ali Khan, spans ten acres in Gurugram. This imposing structure, built in the 1930s, showcases royal heritage and unique architecture. Ibrahim Kothi, once home to Tiger Pataudi, features a dome inspired by the Sanchi Stupa. Saif Ali Khan repurchased the leased estate in 2014, returning it to family ownership. The palace remains a significant symbol of the Pataudi family's rich history.

title: Delhi man, 22, stabbed 17 times near school over suspected affair
content: A 22-year-old man died after being stabbed seventeen times in east Delhi's Mandawali area.  The fatal altercation occurred near a school on Thursday evening following a dispute.  Police rushed the injured Vansh Dedha to a hospital where doctors pronounced him dead.  One accused, Keshav Kumar, was arrested while his associate is being sought.  Authorities are reviewing CCTV footage and technical surveillance for further investigation.

title: Samantha Ruth Prabhu recalls myositis battle: 'I had no control'

She discovered strength, hope, and faith while navigating through the struggles of her illness. Additionally, she shared the joyful news of her pregnancy during the shooting of a music video, eagerly looking forward to the arrival of her first child.

title: Karnataka govt limits Vande Mataram to 2 stanzas, barring VVIP functions

The decision follows a Union home ministry guideline for singing all six stanzas. The state government aims for uniformity and appropriate protocol during national song renditions. This move occurs amidst a political controversy surrounding the national song's singing.

title: ED raids Ramnandi Hotels across 9 locations in alleged Rs 132-crore bank fraud case

The company allegedly used fake reports and personal guarantees to secure these funds.  Five pledged properties were reportedly sold at undervalued prices recently.  The agency suspects these actions aimed to prevent asset attachment and recover crime proceeds.

This ruling highlights the misuse of consumer protection laws for personal gain.
